special.Why it Impresses: You understand how Meta/Google make money (ads). Use a massive dataset to predict if a user clicks an ad.
Predict which new YouTube video will go viral in 48 hours based on title, description, and comments.
Build a tool that tells a creator the best time and filter to post to maximize reach.
Using public NYC Taxi data, detect unusual traffic patterns (accidents/events) in real-time.
Build a model that scores how "natural" a machine translation sounds compared to a human.
Build a lightweight NLP model that suggests 3 contextual replies to an incoming email/message.
Predict which users will cancel their subscription next month based on listening/watching habits.
A model that correctly assigns credit to Facebook, Google, and TikTok ads for a final sale (crucial for Meta).
Simulate 10 warehouse robots moving packages without colliding (Reinforcement Learning basics).
Build a dashboard that flags sudden spikes in cloud computing costs (NVIDIA/Amazon love cost-savers).
Given wind and weather data, predict if a drone can deliver a package within 30 minutes.
Predict how much VRAM a deep learning model will need before training starts (huge for NVIDIA).
Use NLP to scrape 1,000 reviews and summarize the top 3 pros and cons automatically.
Predict how many units of a product to stock in each country 3 months ahead.
Classify which product reviews on Amazon are written by bots vs. real humans.
Use Apple's open CoreML data to classify if a user is walking, running, or driving using only motion sensors.
Use public SpaceX telemetry data to predict if the booster will land successfully on the drone ship.
Build a CV model that detects clouds in satellite images so SpaceX/NASA know which photos are unusable.
An on-device AI that detects and blurs faces in photos without sending data to the cloud.
Predict how many charge cycles an iPhone/MacBook battery has left based on usage patterns.
Build a "fact-checker" that takes a ChatGPT response and flags claims that are not supported by a given PDF.
Build a system that detects if a user is trying to hack an AI by giving malicious prompts (jailbreak detection).
Build a RAG chatbot that recruiters can "talk to" to ask questions about your skills (very novel).
Build a classifier that detects if an essay was written by a student or by ChatGPT.
Simulate 3 AI agents debating a topic (e.g., Climate Change) to see if they reach a consensus (shows advanced thinking).
Take a dataset of comments and automatically rewrite toxic ones to be neutral without changing meaning.
Scrape SEC financial filings and use NLP to auto-generate a company's Strengths/Weaknesses.
Build a YOLO model that detects pedestrians/cars on a video feed (autonomous driving basic).
Show a live dashboard where positive/negative news moves a simulated stock price (trading bot demo).
Build a project that automatically scrapes data, trains a model, evaluates it, and deploys it via a REST API. This single project beats 10 simple projects.
